content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Life science research tools and clinical diagnostics for labs, unlike Masimo's noninvasive patient monitoring and wearables."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Orthopedic pain devices, bone healing stimulators and biologics sold to surgeons, not patient monitoring."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Cloud practice management and outsourced revenue cycle services, with no monitoring devices or sensors."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Wearable continuous monitoring sensors with apps, sold to patients, pharmacies and health systems, closely matching Masimo's wearables model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Implantable heart valves are the core business; its monitoring unit is secondary to Masimo's sensor and monitor focus."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Joint implants, bracing and rehabilitation devices for orthopedic surgeons, a different product set and customer base."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Blood collection and processing equipment with disposable kits for blood centers, not patient monitoring."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Contract manufacturer of components and devices for device OEMs, not a branded monitoring device seller."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Neurosurgical instruments, dural implants and regenerative matrices for surgeons, not monitoring devices."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Sterilization indicators and lab quality control instruments for manufacturers and labs, not patient monitoring."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Radiation detection and dosimetry for nuclear and defense customers, a different technology and end market."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Patient-used respiratory devices with masks and cloud therapy monitoring, sold to providers and consumers, similar to Masimo's model."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Medical tapes, dental aligners and coding and documentation software, a diversified mix unlike Masimo's monitoring focus."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Sterilizers, surgical tables and contract sterilization services for hospitals and drug makers, not patient monitoring."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Vascular access, interventional and surgical disposables for hospitals, without Masimo's monitoring and sensor business."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Analytical instruments, reagents and contract drug services for life science labs, a different business."}]}
